title: RPS-1: Robo Parametric Standard, Version 0.1 (Working Draft)
description: First public working draft of RPS-1, the Robo Parametric Standard: an open parametric risk standard for AI agents and robotics, published for public comment. It defines system classes, a Core Parameter Matrix, a trigger library, oracle and evidence requirements, the Agent Incident Record (with JSON schema) and certification levels. Prepared by the founders of the RoboIns Association, Zug, Switzerland. Not peer reviewed; all thresholds are provisional.
